caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical metal container with a fitted, flat, circular lid and a curved metal handle attached at two hinge points on opposite sides. The container and the lid are primarily light green in color, with numerous areas of rust and paint chipping throughout, revealing patches of brownish-orange and bare metal underneath. The handle is slightly curved and matches the color and worn, rusted appearance of the container. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, and there are no additional objects or decorative elements in the composition. The artist's signature and the year 1933 are visible in small text at the lower right corner.
title: Sugar Pail with Cover
